newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom open weak on requote.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom open weak on requote.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian transportation and industrial group, Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB), Hicom Holdings Bhd, and Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton), opened lower on being requoted on Monday.
At the open, Proton was down 30 cents to 15.70 ringgit, Gadek was down 30 at 19.50 and Hicom down 40 at 6.70.
The shares had been suspended last Tuesday following group chairman Yahaya Ahmad's death, who was killed in a helicopter crash late on Monday night.
Other Yahaya linked companies like Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB), Gadek Capital Bhd, Edaran Otomobil Nasional Bhd and Eastern Pacific Industries Corp Bhd were down between 10 and 90 cents.
Analysts said over the weekend they expected the shares to be weaker on the opening as there had been a build-up of selling pressure following uncertainties over the group after Yahaya's death.
